definitions.meaning: A prayer-house, an oratory, house of prayer

source_text: ge-béd-hús, es; n. A prayer-house, an oratory, house of prayer; or&a-long;t&o-long;rium, d&e-short;mus or&a-long;ti&o-long;nis :-- Habbaþ ða wíc gebéd-hús the dwellings have a prayer-house, Bd. 5, 2; S. 614, 33. Mín hús biþ genemned gebéd-hús d&o-short;mus mea d&o-short;mus or&a-long;ti&o-long;nis voc&a-long;bitur, Mk. Bos. 11, 17. Godes cyrce is úre gebéd-hús God's church is our prayer-house, Homl. Th. ii. 584, 3. [O. H. Ger. gabethús.]
